kb_proposals: To prove a LocalModel predicate for a model whose LocalModel instance takes a refutable hypothesis, state the predicate's body on the model DATA (Y, G, causalityY, singY explicit) and bridge by `obtain ⟨cs, hg⟩ := s; exact @h M _ _ _ _ cs hg ...` (definitional): the proof is then non-vacuous (GX.E0CBG.sliceFutureBTZ_of).

A Str of a LocalModel built from explicit data: `show Σ' cs : ChartedSpace E0Y M, @HasGroupoid E0Y _ M _ cs e0Groupoid from ⟨inferInstance, inferInstance⟩` (an anonymous constructor fails: the metavariable of the first component is unassigned when the second is elaborated).

The limit of psi at a boundary point along a monotone causal family: put the family in a compact diamond (GH), show any cluster point lies above (resp. below) every member (J± closed by GH + tarentin) and hence below every other cluster point; N causal gives uniqueness, IsCompact.tendsto_nhds_of_unique_mapClusterPt gives convergence (GX.E0CBG.e0_germExtFutureBTZ, e0_germExtPastBTZ_of).

Rigidity at a boundary point without Z-: for an open O0 ∋ p, take K ⊆ O0 causally convex (strong causality from GH + tarentin) and a point z' ∈ U ∩ K with J+(z') (or I+ (z')) a neighbourhood of p; every y ∈ U near p is then joined to z' inside K ∩ U (germ_isPreconnected_between + convexity), so O ∩ U lies in the component of O0 ∩ U through z'.

A chart isomorphism is an IsEMorphismOn on its source with no local model (GX.E0CBG.isEMorphismOn_of_chartIso): FromModel's chart_isEMorphismOn and slice_assemble use only ChartIso; paperChart = chartAt ≫ E0.paperOfY gives E0's paper coordinates on any E0-manifold.
